name: rehearse
description: Splits a job into stages and has each one done by hand against the real target before any code: a worker looks and registers the stage's ending, you confirm it in plain words, a worker builds until it passes, and an independent director checks every stage and the whole job. Turn it on by starting a prompt with 'rehearse'.

confirm_ending.title: Confirm the ending
confirm_ending.description: Ask you to confirm the goal, the plan and each ending before any edit. Turn off for unattended runs; endings are then marked not confirmed by a person.

max_strikes.title: Strikes per stage
max_strikes.description: How many relocks and director reworks a stage may take before it is stuck (unattended: the job ends with a not fixed report).

loop_breaker_rounds.title: Loop breaker rounds
loop_breaker_rounds.description: Failing runs in a row before edits lock again.

director_model.title: Director model
director_model.description: The model the director runs on.

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: The model the look and build workers run on.
